name: How long does it take to remove a bathroom shower?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to remove a bathroom shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Removing a standard bathroom shower typically takes one to two days for demolition and cleanup. The exact duration depends on the construction materials and whether hidden problems exist behind the walls. Prefabricated fiberglass or acrylic units detach relatively quickly, while custom tile-and-mortar assemblies require heavy labor to chip down to the framing. If technicians uncover water damage, mold, or deteriorated subflooring once the surround is pulled away, structural repairs or framing adjustments will add time before the area is ready for new installations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Removing a standard shower usually takes one to two days. Heavy tile, mortar beds, or hidden water damage behind the walls can extend the demolition and repair timeline.
